redfin.remarks: Prime Koreatown Covered Land Play, House-Hack, & High-Density Development Opportunity! This versatile setup is perfect for an owner-user looking to occupy the entire property, or "house-hack" by living in one unit while offsetting the mortgage with substantial supplemental income from the others. It is equally lucrative for traditional investors and developers alike. Situated on a prime ±5,901 sq. ft. flat lot in the high-demand rental core of Los Angeles (90006), 1107 S Mariposa Ave represents the ultimate multi-tier investment asset. Operating with an SFR footprint but uniquely optimized for maximum revenue, the property features a turnkey, high-yield co-living configuration in the front building paired with a detached back unit. Crucially, 100% of the current tenants are on Month-to-Month leases at rates significantly below market standards, delivering an incoming buyer unparalleled operational flexibility. This ensures an immediate path to aggressive market-rate stabilization for a value-add buyer, or a frictionless timeline for a developer looking to clear the site. While generating resilient holding income, buyers can leverage the property's premium R3-1 zoning and Transit Oriented Communities (TOC) eligibility. This high-density transit corridor designation unlocks massive development incentives , including enhanced Floor Area Ratios (FAR), increased height allowances , and dramatically reduced parking requirements that slash subterranean construction costs. With an established proof of concept directly in the immediate submarket—notably demonstrated by the successful recent development at 1110 S Mariposa Ave—this asset is an incredibly secure, low-overhead wealth-preservation vehicle in one of Southern California's most supply-constrained rental markets!
